newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money rates steady to firmer in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: HK money rates steady to firmer in thin trade.

text.p: Interbank rates were steady to firmer on Tuesday in featureless and quiet pre-Christmas trading with light demand on the short-end, dealers said.
The local interbank and bill/bond markets will be closed on Wednesday and Thursday for Christmas and reopen on Friday.
Overnight money rose to 4-13/15 3/4 percent from 4-1/2 3/8 percent at Monday midday but three-month money was virtually unchanged at 5-9/16 7/16 percent.
"Light short-covering was seen on the overnights and there was almost no trading on longer-term money," a dealer said, adding many of the traders had already left for the holidays.
